variables.vac: {{ 'vacuum.zorik' if states('vacuum.zorik') not in ['unavailable', 'unknown'] else ('vacuum.robotic_vacuum_cleaner' if states('vacuum.robotic_vacuum_cleaner') not in ['unavailable', 'unknown'] else 'none') }}

variables.want: {% set a = states('alarm_control_panel.home') %}{% set s = states(vac) %}{% set d = states('sensor.zorik_last_clean_begin') | as_datetime(none) %}{% set cleaned = d is not none and (d | as_local).strftime('%Y-%m-%d') == now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d') %}{% set h = now().hour %}{% if vac == 'none' %}none{% elif trigger.id == 'away' %}{{ 'start' if a == 'armed_away' and s == 'docked' and not cleaned and 8 <= h < 20 else 'none' }}{% elif trigger.id == 'back' %}{{ 'dock' if a != 'armed_away' and s == 'cleaning' else 'none' }}{% else %}none{% endif %}

description: Ten minutes into Away, start the robot once a day (08:00-20:00) from the dock; dock it when the house leaves Away. vacuum.zorik (Roborock cloud) and vacuum.robotic_vacuum_cleaner (Matter) are the same robot: Roborock first, Matter as fallback.
